meta.query_interpretation: Interpreted as a relationship question, rendered as a network graph.
assumptions: Interpreted 'co-occur in combination studies' as a drug-drug relationship centered on pembrolizumab.
warnings: Fetched 600 of 2,922 matching trials (capped at max_studies=600); figures below describe that sample, not the full result set.
Merged brand and generic names into 16 shared compound node(s) using RxNorm; each merged node lists its source names.
Graph truncated to 30 nodes for readability, by keeping the nodes appearing in the most trials.
Node sizes count every fetched trial the node appears in, including trials whose other drugs were pruned from the drawing, so a node can be larger than its visible edges alone would suggest.
Edges require at least 2 shared trials; single-trial co-occurrences are omitted as incidental.
